name: Final Kuts
tagline: Downtown Vacaville's 5-star barbershop. Clean cuts, good conversation, and barbers who are great with kids.
seoTitle: Final Kuts Barbershop | Barber in Downtown Vacaville, CA
description: Final Kuts Barbershop at 348 Merchant St Ste A, Vacaville, CA. Rated 5.0 stars. Haircuts, beard work, kids' cuts. Walk in or book online. (707) 685-9136.

about.title: Good vibes on Merchant Street.
body: Final Kuts is a downtown Vacaville barbershop with a 5.0 rating across more than 200 reviews. We're all about a lively atmosphere, good conversation, and barbers who take their time.
Bring the kids. Our barbers are patient with children, from first haircuts to fresh fades. Walk in, or pick your barber and book a time on Booksy.

reviews.text: Best spot in town, hands down. No matter who you get, they're all great & always take care of everyone that walks through the door. The atmosphere is lively & the conversations are entertaining. I highly recommend everyone to check out Final Kuts.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Paul is professional, reliable and his shop is pleasant and very clean. He does an excellent job on my hair!!!!
reviews.author: Andrea

reviews.text: My son doesn’t like getting haircuts and Patrick was very patient and understanding. The shop is clean and always good vibes when we visit.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Great experience. My third time going in for a cut with Mare. Friendly, professional and attentive. I am very happy with the cut. Everyone in the shop is very friendly. Great place for a cut and shave. I recommend.
reviews.author: Rick

reviews.text: Amare took our walk-in for my 1year old son’s mullet haircut and not only perfected exactly what I wanted, but also did it in a timely manner which is critically important when cutting a child’s hair! I’m very pleased! I think I’ve found my son’s barber!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Great service Luis is an exceptional barber who pays attention to detail. I left feeling confident highly recommend
reviews.author: Peezy

reviews.text: Andrew is an exceptional barber! He listened to what we needed and cut my son's hair perfectly- crisp and clean. The barbershop is friendly, comfortable professional and close to places to have a bite while you wait for someone.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Patrick is excellent! Super friendly and chill environment
reviews.author: Vincent

reviews.text: This is a great barber shop, friendly professional and great cuts. Great for walk ins..
reviews.author: Johnny C.

reviews.text: Great atmosphere. My son got a regular hair cut from Paul. He was very attentive, asking questions to ensure he got what he wanted.

faq.a: Yes! Walk-ins are welcome, and we've even done walk-in cuts for 1-year-olds. To skip the wait, book your barber online.

faq.q: How do I book a specific barber?
faq.a: Each of us has our own booking page: Hollywood The Barber, Patrick, Marethebarber and Luis. Just tap the Book buttons above.
A standard men's haircut is $40–$45, depending on the barber. Tap your barber's Book button for current prices.
Yes! Kids' cuts are $35–$50. Mare takes kids 8 and up, and Hollywood's under-6 cuts aren't available Thursday to Saturday.
Yes. Hollywood does after-hours haircuts at $70+, and Patrick does after/before-hours cuts at $70.
Patrick takes credit cards. For the other barbers, give us a call at (707) 685-9136 to confirm.
We're open Mon 10 AM–6 PM, Tue–Fri 10 AM–7 PM and Sat 9 AM–6 PM, closed Sunday. Hours can vary a little, so book online or call.
